cctpBridge(uint256,uint32,bytes32,bytes3.details: This endpoint is meant to enable CCTP bridging at the end of a multicall. It also enable integrations with Squid CCTP bridging relayer infrasctructure.Require either ERC20 or permit2 allowance from the user to the router address. Indeed, permit2's transferFrom2 is used instead of regulat transferFrom. Meaning that if there is no regular allowance from user to the router for ERC20 token, permit2 allowance will be used if granted.CCTP's replaceDepositForBurn function is not made available for security reason. Integrators need to be careful with the parameters they provide.Require owner to call `approveCctpTokenMessenger` function first.

params.destinationDomain: Destination chain according to CCTP's nomenclature. This param is checked for potential irrelevant values by CCTP contract. See https://developers.circle.com/stablecoins/docs/cctp-technical-reference.

params.amount: Amount of ERC20 token received. This will match msg.value for native tokens.
params.payload: Value provided by Squid containing the calldata that will be ran on destination chain. Expected format is: abi.encode(ISquidMulticall.Call[] calls, address refundRecipient, bytes32 salt).
params.sourceAddress: Source address on the source chain.
params.sourceChain: Source chain according to the Chainflip Protocol's nomenclature.
params.token: Address of the ERC20 token received. 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE in case of native token.
